anchor_definitions.head: neck_anchor = bottom-centre of the ink bbox; hair_top = top of bbox
anchor_definitions.face: eye_centre / mouth_centre = ink centroids of the upper / lower half
anchor_definitions.facial-hair: chin_anchor = bottom-centre of the ink bbox
anchor_definitions.accessories: bridge = centre of the ink bbox (glasses sit on the nose bridge)
anchor_definitions.body: shoulder_left/right ~ top corners of the bbox; hand_extremes = ink extremes
anchor_definitions.a person: whole bust / sitting / standing template with the head, face, body groups replaceable
